posthoc_scorer_amendment.scope: report discarded covariance eigendirections, fail closed for structural null violations, and freeze cutoff sensitivity without changing the prediction, feature order, covariance estimate, or default displayed P50 statistic

scoring_order: score the existing P50/P49 primary full-curve DeltaM lineage residual first
score the raw asymptotic slope ratio 2^(3/8) as the historical baseline
score this frozen scalar-plus-H4 1/N slope correction without refitting
score the induced finite-slope root ratio
only afterward fit extra powers/logarithms or orientation terms

response_coordinates.mean_slope: p derivative of the orientation-mean matching function at its intrinsic zero
response_coordinates.root_gap_lineage: signed difference of the two implicit matching roots
response_coordinates.P4_S_prime: first p derivative of angular-normalized P4_S
response_coordinates.P4_D_prime: first p derivative of angular-normalized P4_D

covariance_contract: each size is jackknifed internally; independent N145/N290 streams give Cov_child+ratio^2*Cov_parent
evidence_boundary: All nine features at a size reuse the same two-orientation histogram block. The topology anchors type exact observable identities only; levels, slopes, roots, derivatives, ratios, and model corrections remain response/model coordinates and are not separate evidence blocks.
